cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

mechanism: A grants departure only after one more approved household or courtesy task, using the waiting taxi itself to extend the visit.
confusable: A blanket order to stay would miss D26: each new small request must arise when the previous task or departure appears complete.
comparison: Taxi urgency and thanking the driver differ from the other alternative household checks and technical questions.
seedUse: Use D26-b dried cup, storage and driver call; S01 makes leave-taking subject to a continuing permission process.
